name: Softly
author: denonmaryland
description: Tap a key, speak, tap again: local Whisper dictation through Voxtype with a quiet backlit pill, plus a bar popover for sounds, vocabulary, recent transcripts and status.

schema.label: Dictation key
schema.description: Hyprland key name such as F9, Alt_R (Right Alt) or SUPER + H. Pick one under Dictation key in the panel. F9 takes over Omarchy's own F9 dictation binding (stock on Omarchy 4.0, kept by the 4.5 update for people who already dictated); on Omarchy 4.5 Softly also switches off Alt + Space and Right Alt unless you hand dictation to Omarchy in the panel.
